title: Deprecate Wan 2.2 text-to-video - drop t2v_ms, keep the deps for the sweep
description: Wan 2.2 Smooth 14B drops t2v_ms; i2v_ms stays. The t2v pair is DigitalPastel's SmoothMix community merge (2 x 13.55GB, allowNoCredit:false) and LTX 2.3 now owns text-to-video, so the op earns neither its 27.1GB nor its licence exposure. User decisions 2026-08-07: (1) wan-22 t2v_ms only - wan22-5b untouched, i2v_ms survives; (2) wan-22-t2v-high/low STAY in modelDeps.js so _orphanedDepIds can still see them and the uninstall sweep reclaims the 27.1GB already on users' disks - deleting the entries would blind the sweep and strand the files forever; (3) R2 + the HF mirror keep serving the weights, no live destructive op. Also drops the wan22_t2v graph + both templates, its progressStages row, and the desktop op-resolver spec's t2v assertions. Feeds MPI-467's smoke budget: 312.2GB -> 285.1GB.

attention.reason: Two checks need the user's own app: one real Wan 2.2 i2v generation, and a look at the Model Library tile now that wan-22 renders a single Image to Video toggle. Everything provable without a GPU is green (npm test 478/478, test:desktop 17/17).
